name: atlias-pipeline
description: Default-off collectors for the local planner and reporter: the exact original and follow-up prompts and the selected skills, native receipts that count only with a numeric exit code, and an optional evidence-record style. No model call; every other event passes through unchanged.

enabled.title: Atlias pipeline collectors
enabled.description: Master switch. Off registers nothing. Every option below needs this on.

collectAuthority.title: Record original and follow-up prompts
collectAuthority.description: Keep the exact text of each of the person's own prompts, in order, and each selected skill's exact text, in the session store. Needs the master switch on.

collectReceipts.title: Record check receipts
collectReceipts.description: After a Bash or PowerShell call, record its exit code when the native result carries a numeric one; otherwise the receipt is unknown. Edits make earlier receipts stale. Needs Record original and follow-up prompts on.

evidenceRecordStyle.title: Evidence record style
evidenceRecordStyle.description: Add one constant instruction asking for the shortest complete evidence record at the end of each reply. It saves no generated tokens by itself. Needs the master switch on.
